figurative_meaning_en: Not earning a living; being unemployed
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চাকরি হারানোর পর থেকে ভেরেণ্ডা ভাজা করছে।
গ্রামে অনেক যুবক এখন ভেরেণ্ডা ভাজা অবস্থায় আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has been twiddling his thumbs since losing his job.
Many young men in the village are now sitting idle without work.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of idleness in traditional Bengali homes with verandas, common in rural settings.
